KeysToEntries.LevelInstruction.Agility: Run courses and traverse the world
KeysToEntries.Notification.PlayerLeftCourse: Return to course or be disqualified!
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Resilience: Reduces the amount of stamina lost when evading.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_AirDash: While airborne dash forwards covering a short distance quickly.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_StaminaPotion: Unlocks the recipe to craft Stamina Potions that can stop stamina drain when running.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Breakfall: You now roll when falling a great distance. Increases the distance beforefall damage is taken and reduces fall damage.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Haste: Increase your run and sprint speeds to that of mounts briefly
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Crevices: Allows you to use Crevices and squeeze through small gaps in large hills or mountains to get to the other side quickly.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_WindstepUpgrade: Stagger nearby enemies when landing from Windstep.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Nomad: Increases the amount of passive experience gained from exploration.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_DoubleJump: Allows the use of a second jump while airborne.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Skillcape: A true showcase of Skill Mastery. Unlocks the ability to craft and wear the Agility Skillcape.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_KebbitBurrows_Common:
Allows the use of the Brynmoor & Ghornfell Burrow networks.

Burrows let you travel through the underground tunnel network of the Kebbits. These burrows cover great distances and can go between regions.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_KebbitBurrows_Wild: Allows the use of the Fellhollow Burrow network. Additionally the chance of taking damage and the amount received are reduced.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_KebbitBurrows_Desert: Allows the use of the Umbral Sands Burrow network. Additionally the chance of taking damage and the amount received are reduced.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Trailblazer: Increases the amount of passive experience gained from exploration.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.LevelTooLow: Requires a higher Agility level to use this Burrow.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.BurrowNotClea: Use a spade to clear the Burrow.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.NetworkNotUnl: Clear at least one other Burrow to use the Kebbit Burrow network.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage1: You took damage. You inhaled a mouthful of dirt in the burrows.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage2: You took damage. You disturbed a sleeping Kebbit, who promptly bit you.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage3: You took damage. Some tree roots jabbed into your ribs.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage4: You took damage. Part of the network collapsed and landed on you.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage5: You took damage. You slipped on some ground water.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_KebbitBurrows_Razorbacke: Further reduces the chance of taking damage and the amount received when traveling through the Kebbit Burrow network.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage6: You took damage. You got stuck between two rocks.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage7: You took damage trying to squeeze through a narrow tunnel
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage8: You took damage. A pack of Kebbits attacked you.
KeysToEntries.Notification.KebbitBurrows.Damage9: You took damage. You fell into a hidden chamber on the way.
KeysToEntries.Magic.Recall.Name: Recall
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Recall: Places a temporary beacon at your current location, allowing you to return to it within a limited time.
KeysToEntries.PerkDescription_Recall_Upgrade: Recall now automatically triggers upon receiving fatal fall damage, protecting the caster.
KeysToEntries.Magic.PhaseDash.Name: Phase dash
KeysToEntries.PerkDecriptions_KebbitBurrows_Dark: Allows the use of the Dowdun Reach Burrow network. Additionally the chance of taking damage and the amount received are reduced.
KeysToEntries.Magic.PhaseDash.Description: Allows the use of a second dash whilst airborne.
